response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with deep experience across languages (D, TypeScript, C/C++, Java) and infrastructure, but his resume shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics systems, or growth engineering — the core focus of this Principal-level Growth/Experimentation role. His trajectory is Senior/Staff level rather than Principal/IC6 with demonstrated cross-team platform leadership at enterprise scale, and there's no mention of statistical analysis, rollout risk management, or partnering with Data Science/Product on measurable growth outcomes.
strengths: Broad, deep technical versatility across many languages and platforms (C/C++, Java, TypeScript, D)
Strong systems/infrastructure experience including low-latency, high-throughput services (Sociomantic) and distributed systems basics
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source platform ownership (GISCollective)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, or rollout-risk management
No evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/data-analysis work central to this role
Career level appears Senior/Staff rather than Principal/IC6 with multi-team platform ownership at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering breadth and technical leadership
